QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] Mood Lighting
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1501001##k's logic for leaving the lights off seems flimsy at best... Maybe she can tell you more about how she got into this situation in the first place.
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p1501001##k asked you to help light the house by making #i4036500# #b#t4036500##k. You can do that by double-clicking on the #i2270052# #b#t2270052#s#k near the #r#o3501105#s#k flying around #b#m101083000##k.

And since #b#p1501001##k can't stand to harm any living creatures, she's asked you to thin the #r#o3501105##k population by hunting about #b30#k of them.
QuestInfo.2: The lantern full of wisps lit up the room nicely. It's so cozy now! What's #b#p1501001##k got to say?

0.msg: We need to get some light in here. It's way too dark.

5.msg: Here, I'll give you a couple of empty lanterns. Exit to the right from the Deep Forest Clearing, and you'll find Deep Forest Wisps. Put a couple in the lanterns, and I can use them to light the cottage.

0.msg: Also, if it's not too much trouble, would you mind hunting a few as well? There are so many over there that the light's practically blinding.
What am I supposed to do? Sit in the dark?

default.0: If you leave the cottage and go to the right, you'll find Deep Forest Wisps.\r\nCatch about #b20#k of them in the lanterns and bring them back here for me.

lost.0: Didn't I give you enough lanterns?

yes.0: Try to make a clean job of it, would you? I don't want any escaped wisps on my hands.
